title: Machine checks are not judgment
statement: Keep machine checks apart from human judgment: a quality call stays unjudged until a person has watched or listened, and an AI judge only picks what that person reviews.
detail:
Every number in the first film's QA comes from a measurement on the delivered files, and none replaces a real
audition (`g9-film-v01-render/QA.md`); a review marked a quality call "present, unjudged" where it needed a listen
(`g9/review/2026-10-06-film-reviews/VIDEO-REVIEW.md`); and a successful render is technical proof only
(`g9/tools/unit-video-essay/INTEGRATION.md`). AI judges are a filter: a voice is chosen by listening
(`othello-unit-video/research/METHODS.md`), and automated player runs are muted, so a person still has to watch with
sound (`othello-unit-video/.claude/skills/uvk-checks-make/SKILL.md`).
